title: Mothman Harley-Davidson hosts 3rd Annual End of Summer Bash in Williamstown
excerpt: Mothman Harley-Davidson drew bikers and families to Williamstown Saturday for its 3rd Annual End of Summer Bash with bike contests, live music and stunt shows.
content:
WILLIAMSTOWN, W.Va. (WTAP) - Bikers and families spent a sunny Saturday at Mothman Harley-Davidson for the shop’s third annual End of Summer Bash.

The free event ran Saturday, Oct. 3, from 10 a.m. to 8 p.m. at the dealership in Williamstown, the Mid-Ohio Valley’s authorized Harley-Davidson dealer.

Bike competitions were a highlight of the day, with trophies for Best in Show, Best Custom and People’s Choice drawing rows of chrome to the lot.

Live music kept the parking lot lively, with sets from Tongue N’ Cheek and John Richards. Stunt riders with the Golden Globe Riders also performed throughout the day.

Food trucks lined the lot, and the event also offered free tattoos and piercings plus inflatables for kids — giving the rally a family-friendly feel alongside the bikes.

The End of Summer Bash has become a fall tradition for the dealership as riding season winds down, bringing riders and neighbors together before winter.
